## Details

[Great Tables](https://posit-dev.github.io/great-tables/) creates polished presentation tables with headers, annotations, value formatting, color scales, and targeted styles. Use a [data grid](../data-grid/index.qmd) instead when users need to sort, filter, select, or edit the data, or [Table](../table/index.qmd) when a plain HTML table is enough.

Great Tables is a separate package, so install it with `pip install great-tables` alongside Shiny. Then:

1. Build and return a `GT` object from a function decorated with `@render_gt`.
2. In Express, the decorated function creates its output automatically.
3. In Core, add `output_gt("id")` to the UI and give the decorated function the same name.

Shiny reruns the function whenever any reactive values it reads change, so the table can respond to inputs just like other outputs.

See the [Great Tables user guide](https://posit-dev.github.io/great-tables/user-guide/introduction.html) for the full set of formatting and styling options.
